events.did: paused with his hand on the cold steel of the unlocked metal door and drew the inhaler from his coat
events.quote_anchor: The door was unlocked, but as Victor brought his hand to the cold steel he paused, and drew the inhaler from his coat.

events.did: held the inhaler to the light and studied the violet liquid in the cartridge, calculating how much he would need
events.quote_anchor: He held it to the light, studying the violet liquid in the cartridge, calculating how much he’d need.

events.did: asked Victor whether he was ready
events.quote_anchor: “Hey, Vic,” said a voice in his ear. “Are you ready?”

events.did: tugged his mouth into a grim smile
events.quote_anchor: His mouth tugged into a grim smile. Of all the ways this could have gone. All the paths and permutations.

events.did: said he was ready and pushed open the door
events.quote_anchor: “I’m ready,” he said, pushing open the door.
